title: Short pitch to a decision maker
when_to_use: A pitch of a minute or two, spoken or written, asking a decision maker for a next step.
facts_hint: paste the numbers and named cases the pitch may use

personas.description: Decision maker who hears many pitches a month, decides on cost and risk, and distrusts buzzwords.

dimensions.name: Structure
dimensions.question: After one hearing, can the persona retell the problem, the answer and the ask?

anchors.1: the persona cannot say what is proposed or what is asked
anchors.3: problem and answer are retellable, the ask is missing or vague
anchors.5: problem, answer and a concrete ask are each retellable in one sentence, in that order

dimensions.name: Relevance to the persona
dimensions.question: Is the gain stated in the persona's own metric?

anchors.1: generic: the pitch would work unchanged for any listener
anchors.3: the persona's context is named, but the gain is not in their metric
anchors.5: the gain is stated in the persona's metric with one number they can check

dimensions.name: Evidence
dimensions.question: Is every claim backed by a fact the persona could verify?

anchors.3: one number or case, the rest asserted
anchors.5: every claim carries a number or a named case consistent with the facts

measured.description: reading time in seconds at 150 words a minute, 60 or fewer
